scenes.title: Start with the right scope
scenes.footnote: Original illustrated guide, not a live screen recording. UI instructions are based on v9.1.2 source.

cues.en: Welcome to Easy Multi Profiler Web, version nine point one point two. This illustrated guide covers the metadata-only workflow.
cues.zh: 欢迎使用 EasyMultiProfiler-Web 9.1.2。本图解教程介绍元数据工作流。

cues.en: You can review public data and prepare analysis plans. Raw read downloads and R analysis are not connected in this mode.
cues.zh: 可以查看公开数据并准备分析计划。此模式尚未接入原始 reads 下载和 R 分析。

scenes.title: Launch the metadata page
scenes.footnote: Evidence: assets/evidence/launcher-check.json. Keep the terminal open while using the page.

cues.en: From the repository folder, run the dependency check, then start the metadata launcher. Keep that terminal open.
cues.zh: 在仓库目录运行依赖检查，再启动元数据服务。使用页面时请保持终端开启。

cues.en: Open the local address shown here. Python version three point ten or later is required. R is not needed for metadata.
cues.zh: 打开此处显示的本地地址。需要 Python 3.10 或更高版本；元数据功能不需要 R。

scenes.title: Locate a study or accession
items: GEO 关键词 → 检索 GEO
scenes.footnote: Saved ENA response, not a fresh retrieval in this video. No FASTQ files downloaded.

cues.en: Use a public keyword to search G E O, or enter an accession and read its sample manifest. Review the study before selecting runs.
cues.zh: 输入公开关键词检索 GEO，或输入 accession 读取样本清单。选择 runs 前先核对研究。

cues.en: This saved public example lists one paired-end run and two FASTQ links. These are metadata records, not downloaded reads.
cues.zh: 此已保存的公开示例列出一个双端 run 和两个 FASTQ 链接。它们只是元数据，不是已下载的 reads。

scenes.title: Select deliberately, then preflight
right_items: Archive size is not total workspace
Reference and temporary files add space
Archive MD5 is not locally verified
A selected plan is not execution
scenes.footnote: UI labels: 检查所选下载计划 / 保存计划 JSON. Raw downloads and analysis remain disabled.

cues.en: No runs are selected by default. Check the organism, library strategy, paired-end layout, and biological groups, then inspect the selected download plan.
cues.zh: 默认不选择 run。核对物种、文库策略、单双端和实验分组，再检查所选下载计划。

cues.en: Save the plan as JSON. Reported archive size excludes additional analysis space, and archive checksums have not been verified against local files.
cues.zh: 将计划保存为 JSON。档案报告大小不含额外分析空间，档案校验值也尚未与本地文件核对。

scenes.title: Review a processed matrix
items: Enter a GEO series, e.g. GSE60450
Review type, source and byte size
right_items: A filename is not raw-count evidence
scenes.footnote: A confirmed small matrix download is separate from the unavailable raw-FASTQ download workflow.

cues.en: For processed data, enter a G E O series in the matrix section and discover its supplementary files. Inspect each candidate before confirming a download.
cues.zh: 在已处理矩阵区输入 GEO 系列编号并发现补充文件。确认下载前，先审阅每个候选文件。

cues.en: Only supported text tables with a known size of at most thirty-two mebibytes can be downloaded. Archive bundles are not automatically unpacked.
cues.zh: 仅支持已知大小不超过 32 MiB 的指定文本表格；不会自动解包归档文件。

scenes.title: Prove the input, match the samples
scenes.zh_title: 核实数据类型，匹配样本
right_items: Integers alone do not prove raw counts
Match annotation by exact sample ID
scenes.footnote: Saved download check: publisher_checksum_verified = false; deseq2_ready = false. No analysis performed.

cues.en: A saved inspection of the example matrix found twenty-seven thousand, one hundred seventy-nine features and twelve samples. The Length column was excluded.
cues.zh: 已保存的示例矩阵检查发现 27,179 个特征和 12 个样本；Length 列已排除。

cues.en: Integer values alone do not prove raw counts. Check the authors' methods, and match sample annotations by exact identifiers rather than column order.
cues.zh: 整数本身不能证明是原始计数。请核对作者方法，并按精确标识符匹配样本注释，而非按列顺序。

scenes.title: Build and validate the plan
items: Set test / reference groups and batch
scenes.footnote: Validator result is real; its input is an explicitly synthetic teaching fixture, not a biological analysis.

cues.en: Choose a bulk R N A sequencing template. Review the steps, dataset provenance, sample labels, contrast, and any batch terms, then validate the design.
cues.zh: 选择 bulk RNA-seq 模板。核对步骤、数据来源、样本标签、比较组和批次，再校验统计设计。

cues.en: This synthetic teaching plan passes validation, but executable is still false. Passing preflight does not mean an analysis has run.
cues.zh: 此人工教学计划通过了校验，但 executable 仍为 false。预检通过不代表已经运行分析。

scenes.title: Keep papers and AI boundaries clear
scenes.zh_title: 明确论文与 AI 的边界
items: Local PDF extraction: at most 15 MiB
PubMed search is a separate action
Public metadata is evidence, not authority
right_items: No model request made for this video
scenes.footnote: If configured later: preview selected sanitized context and obtain provider-specific consent before sending.

cues.en: The paper section can extract accession candidates from a local P D F. PubMed search is separate, and a candidate still needs scientific verification.
cues.zh: 论文区可从本地 PDF 提取候选 accession。PubMed 检索是独立操作，候选仍需科学核实。

cues.en: The agent is unconfigured here. If you configure a provider later, preview the selected context and consent before sending. The tools remain read-only.
cues.zh: 此处尚未配置智能体。以后配置 Provider 时，应先预览所选上下文并确认发送；工具仍是只读的。

scenes.title: Finish with a reproducible review
items: Reviewed plan JSON and validation results
scenes.footnote: English offline synthetic narration · Chinese / English subtitles · No R or AI execution claimed.

cues.en: Keep your data sources, sample mapping, and plan together. Discovery, input verification, and execution are different steps. This mode supports review and planning.
cues.zh: 请保留数据来源、样本映射和流程计划。发现、输入验证与执行是不同步骤；此模式支持审阅和规划。
